papers.title: Building Engagement Using Financial Incentives for Colorectal Cancer Screening (BENEFIT-C) in a Rural Louisiana Federally Qualified Health Center
papers.authors: Perry L, Peacock E, LeBlanc A, Williams L, Wiltz G, Krousel-Wood M
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the preliminary effectiveness and feasibility of a community-engaged financial incentive intervention for increasing colorectal cancer (CRC) screening in a rural, low-resource primary care setting.
STUDY SETTING AND DESIGN: A feasibility pilot trial at a federally qualified health center in the Acadiana region, Louisiana. Participants were identified via electronic health records (EHR), recruited by telephone, and randomized to intervention (n = 25) or control (n = 25). Both groups received incentives for flu and COVID-19 vaccines. The intervention group also received incentives for CRC screening. Fisher's Exact tests evaluated between-group differences in completion of CRC screening (primary outcome), flu, and COVID-19 vaccines 2 months post-enrollment.
DATA SOURCES AND ANALYTIC SAMPLE: Eligible patients were aged 45-75, due for CRC screening, and English-speaking. From November 11, 2023 to March 31, 2024, completion of each outcome was obtained from the EHR.
PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: 57% of interested individuals were eligible; 94% of eligible individuals enrolled. Participants were 70% female, 42% Black, 24% uninsured, with a mean age of 52.4 years. Completion of CRC screening was higher in the intervention versus control group (17 [68%] vs. 8 [32%], p = 0.02).
CONCLUSION: Financial incentives significantly increased completion of CRC screening. Future research should confirm findings in larger samples and evaluate cost-effectiveness to inform health system policies.
papers.title_zh: 利用財務誘因提升大腸直腸癌篩檢參與度（BENEFIT-C）：於路易斯安那州鄉村聯邦合格健康中心之研究
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：評估社區參與式財務誘因介入措施，在鄉村、資源有限的基層照護場域中，提升大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢率之初步成效與可行性。研究場域與設計：於路易斯安那州Acadiana地區一家聯邦合格健康中心進行可行性先驅試驗。參與者透過電子病歷（EHR）篩選，以電話招募，並隨機分配至介入組（n=25）或對照組（n=25）。兩組皆接受流感疫苗與COVID-19疫苗之財務誘因，介入組額外接受大腸直腸癌篩檢之財務誘因。以Fisher精確檢定評估兩組在登記後2個月，大腸直腸癌篩檢完成率（主要結果）、流感疫苗與COVID-19疫苗接種完成率之組間差異。資料來源與分析樣本：符合資格之病患年齡介於45-75歲、符合大腸直腸癌篩檢時機、且能使用英語溝通。自2023年11月11日至2024年3月31日，各項結果之完成情形皆由電子病歷取得。主要發現：57%有興趣者符合資格；94%符合資格者完成註冊。參與者70%為女性、42%為黑人、24%無保險，平均年齡52.4歲。介入組大腸直腸癌篩檢完成率高於對照組（17人[68%] vs. 8人[32%]，p=0.02）。結論：財務誘因顯著提升大腸直腸癌篩檢完成率。未來研究應於更大樣本中確認此發現，並評估成本效益以供醫療體系政策參考。

papers.title: cGAS‑STING pathway in digestive tract cancer: From molecular mechanisms to therapeutic applications (Review)
papers.authors: Chen T, Zhang J, Sun J, Zhang H, Huang D, Ye H
papers.abstract: As a classic cytosolic DNA sensor, the cyclic GMP‑AMP synthase (cGAS)‑stimulator of interferon genes (STING) pathway contributes to the secretion of multiple inflammatory molecules and functions as a suppressor or promoter in tumor development. Currently, the effect of this pathway on digestive tract cancer types remains unclear, which may be due to its paradoxical roles in different cell types. Tumor cells in digestive cancer often employ multiple mechanisms to inhibit this pathway activation, which then restricts the infiltration of antitumor immune cells and facilitates the formation of an immunosuppressive microenvironment. However, cGAS‑STING pathway activation also influences the function of multiple immune cells. For example, while it mainly potentiates the function of dendritic cells and natural killer cells in the tumor microenvironment, it can also promote macrophage polarization into the immunosuppressive M2 subset. To improve the understanding of the cGAS‑STING pathway in digestive cancer types, the present article systematically reviews the regulatory mechanism and effects of this pathway across different malignancies of the digestive system, including oral cavity, esophageal, gastric, hepatobiliary, pancreatic and colorectal cancer. Furthermore, the present review examines potential stimulatory strategies and future directions to utilize this pathway against tumors, such as inducing DNA damage, removing cell‑intrinsic inhibitory signals and direct activation by agonists. Overall, the present review aims to provide new perspectives and ideas for leveraging the cGAS‑STING pathway to exert antitumor effects by highlighting the changes and roles of this pathway in digestive tract cancer types.

papers.title_zh: 消化道癌症中的 cGAS-STING 路徑：從分子機制到治療應用（綜述）
papers.abstract_zh: 作為經典的細胞質DNA感測器，環狀GMP-AMP合成酶（cGAS）-干擾素基因刺激蛋白（STING）路徑參與多種發炎分子的分泌，並在腫瘤發展中扮演抑制者或促進者的角色。目前，此路徑對消化道癌症類型的影響仍不明確，這可能是由於其在不同細胞類型中具有矛盾的角色。消化道癌症中的腫瘤細胞常採用多種機制抑制此路徑的活化，進而限制抗腫瘤免疫細胞的浸潤，並促成免疫抑制性微環境的形成。然而，cGAS-STING路徑的活化也會影響多種免疫細胞的功能。例如，雖然它主要增強腫瘤微環境中樹突狀細胞與自然殺手細胞的功能，但也可能促進巨噬細胞極化為免疫抑制性的M2亞型。為增進對消化道癌症中cGAS-STING路徑的理解，本文系統性地回顧此路徑在消化系統不同惡性腫瘤（包括口腔癌、食道癌、胃癌、肝膽癌、胰臟癌與大腸直腸癌）中的調控機制與作用。此外，本綜述也檢視了潛在的刺激策略與未來方向，以利用此路徑對抗腫瘤，例如誘導DNA損傷、移除細胞內在抑制訊號，以及透過促效劑直接活化。總體而言，本綜述旨在透過強調此路徑在消化道癌症類型中的變化與角色，為利用cGAS-STING路徑發揮抗腫瘤作用提供新的觀點與想法。

papers.title: Plasma lipopolysaccharide-binding protein (LBP), a proxy for intestinal permeability, relates to clinicopathological and immunological disease activity in inflammatory bowel disease patients at diagnosis and during disease course
papers.authors: Barendregt D, Tuk B, Hulleman-van Haaften D, Camman A, Calado B, Grillmaier M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Intestinal barrier healing is the treatment goal in ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn's disease (CD). Despite this, systematic analyses of the relationship between intestinal permeability and clinicopathological and immunological disease activity at diagnosis and during follow-up are lacking. Therefore, we assessed this relationship using plasma lipopolysaccharide-binding protein (LBP)-an indirect biomarker of systemic exposure to bacterial endotoxins-as a proxy for intestinal permeability, in a uniquely well-characterized pediatric inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) cohort.
METHODS: LBP was measured in 1083 longitudinal plasma samples of newly diagnosed pediatric UC (n = 61), CD (n = 115) (PIBD-SETQuality and TISKids prospective cohorts; median follow-up 628 days), and controls (IBD-negative, n = 33; healthy, n = 28). Its relationship with clinicopathological parameters and plasma immune proteomics was examined.
RESULTS: Plasma LBP was elevated and associated with clinicopathological disease activity in therapy-naive CD and UC. In UC, but not CD, LBP related to disease extent, and strongly and independently correlated to endoscopic and histological disease activity, providing additional explanatory value beyond routinely used blood-based biomarkers and inflammatory mediators (including CRP and IL-6). LBP correlated with disease-specific immune profiles linked to severe disease (IL-17/neutrophil/IFN-γ-related profile in UC; IFN-γ-related profile in CD). LBP decreased after induction therapy with corticosteroids in UC, and after exclusive enteral nutrition or anti-TNF (but not corticosteroids) in CD. LBP remained associated with clinicopathological disease activity during follow-up, particularly in UC.
CONCLUSIONS: Plasma LBP relates to clinicopathological and immunological disease activity in IBD-especially UC-at diagnosis and during follow-up, and provides complementary information to routinely used blood-based biomarkers, arguing this simple, inexpensive parameter should be (re)considered for monitoring mucosal inflammation in UC.
papers.title_zh: 血漿脂多醣結合蛋白(LBP)作為腸道通透性之替代指標，與發炎性腸道疾病患者診斷時及病程中臨床病理學及免疫學疾病活動度之相關性
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：腸道屏障癒合是潰瘍性結腸炎(UC)與克隆氏症(CD)的治療目標。儘管如此，關於腸道通透性與診斷時及追蹤期間臨床病理學及免疫學疾病活動度之關係，目前仍缺乏系統性分析。因此，我們使用血漿脂多醣結合蛋白(LBP)——一種反映全身性暴露於細菌內毒素的間接生物標記——作為腸道通透性的替代指標，在一個特徵完整的小兒發炎性腸道疾病(IBD)世代中評估此關係。

方法：於新診斷之小兒UC(n=61)、CD(n=115)（來自PIBD-SETQuality與TISKids前瞻性世代研究；中位追蹤期628天）及對照組（IBD陰性n=33；健康者n=28）共1083個縱向血漿樣本中測量LBP，並檢視其與臨床病理參數及血漿免疫蛋白體學之關係。

結果：在未接受治療的CD及UC病人中，血漿LBP升高並與臨床病理疾病活動度相關。在UC（但非CD）中，LBP與疾病範圍相關，且與內視鏡及組織學疾病活動度呈強烈且獨立的相關性，提供超越常規血液生物標記及發炎介質（包括CRP與IL-6）的額外解釋力。LBP與疾病特異性、與嚴重疾病相關的免疫特徵相關（UC為IL-17/嗜中性球/IFN-γ相關特徵；CD為IFN-γ相關特徵）。UC病人接受類固醇誘導治療後LBP下降，CD病人接受全腸道營養或抗TNF治療後（但非類固醇）LBP下降。追蹤期間LBP持續與臨床病理疾病活動度相關，尤其在UC中更為明顯。

結論：血漿LBP與IBD（尤其是UC）在診斷時及追蹤期間的臨床病理學及免疫學疾病活動度相關，並提供常規血液生物標記之外的互補資訊，主張此簡單、低成本的參數應被（重新）考慮用於監測UC的黏膜發炎。

papers.title: Geriatric Assessment-Based Stratification to Evaluate Treatment Intensity, Quality of Life, and Survival in Older Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer: Protocol for a Prospective Observational Study
papers.authors: Hiramatsu T, Okazaki I, Hosokawa K, Yoshimatsu K, Nagasaka T
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Older patients with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) are a heterogeneous population with wide variability in functional status, frailty, cognition, nutritional reserve, and comorbidity burden. Treatment decisions are often guided primarily by chronological age and performance status, which may not adequately capture vulnerability or patient-centered outcomes in this population.
OBJECTIVE: The primary aim of this study is to prospectively evaluate the association of baseline geriatric assessment (GA)-derived frailty with overall survival in older patients with mCRC receiving first-line systemic therapy in routine clinical practice; secondary aims are to evaluate the associations of frailty with initial treatment intensity and early changes in quality of life (QOL).
METHODS: Baseline GA includes activities of daily living, instrumental activities of daily living, the Clinical Frailty Scale, the Mini-Cog, nutritional assessment, the Charlson Comorbidity Index (excluding cancer-related items), and the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status. Blood-based prognostic biomarkers, including the prognostic nutritional index and neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, are also collected. Initial treatment intensity is defined according to the first-line systemic regimen selected at baseline, whereas subsequent local therapies are recorded separately. QOL is assessed using the European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer Quality of Life Questionnaire Core 30 (EORTC QLQ-C30) at baseline and 8 to 12 weeks after treatment initiation.
RESULTS: This study was registered in the UMIN Clinical Trials Registry (UMIN000060489) on April 1, 2026. This study received no external funding. Participant recruitment began on April 1, 2026 (the first participant enrolled in June 2026) and is planned to continue for approximately 2.5 years (projected completion: October 2028), with an anticipated sample size of approximately 100 participants; an early QOL follow-up is scheduled for 8 to 12 weeks after treatment initiation for each participant. As of the submission of this revised manuscript (August 2026), 4 participants had been enrolled, baseline QOL assessments had been completed for all 4 participants, and the 8- to 12-week follow-up QOL assessments had been completed for 3 participants; no outcome data were available. Analysis of the primary outcome will be conducted after final survival follow-up, with the main results anticipated for publication in 2030.
CONCLUSIONS: This protocol describes a pragmatic GA-based observational framework to examine associations between pretreatment vulnerability, initial treatment intensity, survival outcomes, and patient-reported QOL in older patients with mCRC. Given the exploratory, hypothesis-generating design, the study is expected to generate clinically relevant hypotheses for individualized, patient-centered treatment strategies and future geriatric oncology research.

papers.title_zh: 基於老年評估之分層以評估轉移性大腸直腸癌老年病患之治療強度、生活品質與存活：前瞻性觀察性研究方案
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）老年病患是一個異質性族群，在功能狀態、衰弱程度、認知功能、營養儲備及共病負擔上差異極大。治療決策常主要依據實際年齡與體能狀態（performance status），但這可能無法充分反映此族群的脆弱性或以病患為中心的結果。

目的：本研究主要目的為前瞻性評估基線老年評估（GA）所衍生之衰弱指標，與接受第一線全身性治療之mCRC老年病患整體存活之關聯；次要目的為評估衰弱與初始治療強度及早期生活品質（QOL）變化之關聯。

方法：基線GA包括日常生活活動能力（ADL）、工具性日常生活活動能力（IADL）、臨床衰弱量表（Clinical Frailty Scale）、Mini-Cog認知篩檢、營養評估、Charlson共病指數（排除癌症相關項目）及東岸腫瘤協作組織（ECOG）體能狀態。同時收集血液型預後生物標記，包括預後營養指數及嗜中性球／淋巴球比值。初始治療強度依基線所選第一線全身性療法定義，後續局部治療則另行記錄。QOL於基線及治療開始後8至12週，以歐洲癌症研究與治療組織生活品質問卷核心30題（EORTC QLQ-C30）評估。

結果：本研究已於2026年4月1日在UMIN臨床試驗註冊中心註冊（UMIN000060489）。本研究未接受外部資助。參與者招募於2026年4月1日開始（第一位參與者於2026年6月入組），預計持續約2.5年（預計完成日期：2028年10月），預期樣本數約100人；每位參與者安排於治療開始後8至12週進行早期QOL追蹤。截至本修訂版手稿投稿時（2026年8月），已有4名參與者入組，4名參與者均已完成基線QOL評估，3名已完成8至12週追蹤QOL評估；尚無結果數據可供分析。主要結果之分析將於最終存活追蹤完成後進行，主要結果預計於2030年發表。

結論：本研究方案描述一個務實的、基於GA的觀察性架構，用以檢視mCRC老年病患治療前脆弱性、初始治療強度、存活結果與病患自評QOL之間的關聯。鑑於此為探索性、假說產生型設計，預期本研究將為個人化、以病患為中心之治療策略及未來老年腫瘤學研究，產生具臨床相關性之假說。

試驗註冊：UMIN臨床試驗註冊中心 UMIN000060489；https://tinyurl.com/3mn563er。

國際註冊報告識別碼（IRRID）：DERR1-10.2196/94561。

papers.title: Ulcerative colitis, but not Crohn's disease, displays demographically and clinically driven mucosal immune heterogeneity: implications for patient stratification
papers.authors: De Prado Á, Soleto I, de Castro C, Baldán-Martín M, Del Hierro A, Martínez P
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) encompasses Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC), two conditions with distinct immunopathological profiles despite shared inflammatory pathways. Comparative mucosal and systemic immune characterisation across disease subtypes and clinical variables remains limited. This study aimed to map leukocyte dysregulation in tissue and blood from patients with CD and UC compared to controls.
METHODS: Intestinal tissue and blood samples were obtained from 35 controls and endoscopically active IBD patients, including 54 with CD and 74 with UC. Leukocyte subsets were identified using a 29-marker spectral cytometry panel combining hierarchical gating with unsupervised clustering and dimensionality reduction. Immune composition was stratified by disease location, biological sex, age and endoscopic severity.
RESULTS: Hierarchical gating identified 41 mucosal and 42 circulating immune subsets; unsupervised clustering resolved 51 mucosal and 62 blood clusters. Both diseases displayed dysregulated mucosal immunity relative to controls but with distinct signatures: while CD was mainly T-cell biased, UC showed a mixed infiltrate with an increased relative proportion of NK, NKT and IgG+ B-cells. UC also exhibited substantially greater immunological heterogeneity than CD when stratified by biological sex, age and severity, with effects predominantly confined to the mucosa. Ileal and colonic CD showed minor immunological differences.
CONCLUSIONS: UC displayed more prominent subgroup-associated mucosal immune heterogeneity than CD, particularly according to biological sex, age and endoscopic severity. These findings support tissue-resolved patient stratification in UC and highlight the limited sensitivity of blood-based biomarkers to reflect mucosal immune alterations.

papers.title_zh: 潰瘍性結腸炎（而非克隆氏症）呈現受人口學與臨床因素驅動的黏膜免疫異質性：對病人分層的意義
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）包含克隆氏症（CD）與潰瘍性結腸炎（UC），兩者雖共享發炎路徑，但免疫病理特徵截然不同。目前跨疾病亞型與臨床變項的黏膜與全身免疫比較性特徵描述仍有限。本研究旨在繪製CD與UC病人相對於對照組的組織與血液白血球失調圖譜。方法：收取35名對照者與內視鏡下活動期IBD病人（54名CD、74名UC）的腸道組織與血液檢體。使用29標記的光譜細胞儀面板，結合階層式分群與非監督式分群及降維分析來鑑定白血球亞群。依疾病位置、生理性別、年齡與內視鏡嚴重度進行免疫組成分層。結果：階層式分群鑑定出41種黏膜與42種循環免疫亞群；非監督式分群則解析出51種黏膜與62種血液分群。CD與UC相對於對照組皆呈現黏膜免疫失調，但訊號不同：CD主要以T細胞偏移為主，UC則呈現混合性浸潤，NK、NKT與IgG+ B細胞的相對比例增加。UC在依生理性別、年齡與嚴重度分層時，呈現顯著較CD更大的免疫異質性，且此效應主要侷限於黏膜。迴腸型與結腸型CD之間的免疫差異輕微。結論：UC較CD呈現更顯著的亞群相關黏膜免疫異質性，尤其依生理性別、年齡與內視鏡嚴重度而異。這些發現支持UC應採取組織層級的病人分層，並凸顯血液生物標記對反映黏膜免疫變化的敏感度有限。

papers.title: Pantetheinase Vanin-1 potentiates agonist-induced STING activation via S-cysteaminylation
papers.authors: Liao X, Fu J, Xie C, Liu S, Wang X, Hu M
papers.abstract: Stimulator of interferon genes (STING) is a key player in innate immunity, and its dysregulation has been implicated in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. The activation of STING is regulated by multiple factors, including post-translational modifications (PTMs), but the regulatory network of these PTMs remains incompletely characterized. Here, we report that vascular non-inflammatory molecule-1 (Vanin-1) facilitates STING activation and provide evidence supporting S-cysteaminylation as a previously unrecognized modification of STING. Mechanistically, Vanin-1 hydrolyzes pantetheine to pantothenic acid (vitamin B5) and cysteamine, an aminothiol that promotes S-cysteaminylation of STING at three conserved cysteine residues within the transmembrane domain and potentiates agonist-induced STING activation without directly activating STING. Genetic and pharmacological inhibition of Vanin-1 attenuated STING signaling induced by STING agonists and ameliorated DSS-induced colitis in vivo. Together, our findings reveal a novel regulatory role for Vanin-1 in the cGAS-STING pathway and suggest that Vanin-1 may represent a potential therapeutic target for inflammatory diseases characterized by aberrant cGAS-STING activation.

papers.title_zh: Pantetheinase Vanin-1 透過S-半胱胺化作用增強激動劑誘導的STING活化
papers.abstract_zh: 干擾素基因刺激因子（STING）是先天性免疫的關鍵角色，其失調與自體免疫及發炎性疾病有關。STING的活化受多種因子調控，包括轉譯後修飾（PTMs），但這些PTM的調控網絡尚未完整闡明。本研究發現血管性非發炎分子-1（Vanin-1）可促進STING活化，並提供證據支持S-半胱胺化作用是一種先前未被認識的STING修飾。機轉上，Vanin-1將泛硫乙胺（pantetheine）水解為泛酸（維生素B5）與半胱胺（一種胺基硫醇），後者促進STING穿膜域內三個保守半胱胺酸殘基的S-半胱胺化，並增強激動劑誘導的STING活化，但本身不直接活化STING。基因與藥理學抑制Vanin-1可減弱STING激動劑誘導的STING訊號傳導，並改善體內DSS誘導的結腸炎。總之，本研究揭示Vanin-1在cGAS-STING路徑中的新調控角色，並提示Vanin-1可能是以異常cGAS-STING活化為特徵之發炎性疾病的潛在治療靶點。

papers.title: PET/MR Imaging of the Gastrointestinal Tract
papers.journal: Magn Reson Imaging Clin N Am
papers.journal_full: Magnetic resonance imaging clinics of North America
papers.authors: Bhinder K, Ammirabile A, Zarrintan A, Jadoon A, Goenka A
papers.abstract: PET/MR imaging combines molecular PET data with multiparametric MR imaging in a single reduced-radiation examination of the gastrointestinal tract. For oncologic indications, the hybrid modality adds value in hepatic metastasis detection, locoregional staging, and posttreatment response assessment. Radiotracers beyond fluorodeoxyglucose, including fibroblast activation protein inhibitor ligands and somatostatin receptor analogs, expand diagnostic reach in tumors with low glycolytic activity and in neuroendocrine disease. For inflammatory bowel disease, PET/MR enterography assists with selected questions such as differentiation of inflammatory from fibrotic strictures. This review evaluates current evidence supporting PET/MR imaging across oncologic and nononcologic gastrointestinal applications.

papers.abstract_zh: PET/MR影像結合分子PET資料與多參數MR影像，可在單次檢查中以較低輻射劑量完成胃腸道檢查。在腫瘤學應用上，此混合影像模式在肝轉移偵測、局部區域分期及治療後反應評估上具有附加價值。除了氟去氧葡萄糖（FDG）外，纖維母細胞活化蛋白抑制劑配體（FAPI）與生長抑素受體類似物等新型放射性示蹤劑，擴展了在低糖解活性腫瘤及神經內分泌疾病中的診斷範圍。對於發炎性腸病，PET/MR腸造影檢查有助於解決特定臨床問題，例如區分發炎性與纖維化狹窄。本綜述評估目前支持PET/MR影像於腫瘤學與非腫瘤學胃腸道應用之證據。

papers.title: Imaging Updates in Inflammatory Bowel Disease
papers.journal: Magn Reson Imaging Clin N Am
papers.journal_full: Magnetic resonance imaging clinics of North America
papers.authors: Consul N, Rimola J, Al-Hawary M, Wasnik A
papers.abstract: Magnetic resonance enterography (MRE) is a key noninvasive imaging modality for the diagnosis and longitudinal assessment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), particularly Crohn's disease. The global burden of IBD is increasing, with millions affected in North America and Europe and rapidly rising incidence in Asia and Africa. Standardized acquisition protocols improve consistency and diagnostic accuracy. As therapeutic options expand and patient outcomes improve, MRE interpretation has evolved beyond detection toward disease phenotype characterization and prognostic indicator assessment. Integration of MRE findings with updated disease activity indices and response criteria is essential to guide clinical decision-making in contemporary IBD care.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病之影像學新進展
papers.abstract_zh: 磁振腸造影（MRE）是發炎性腸道疾病（IBD），尤其是克隆氏症，診斷與長期追蹤的重要非侵入性影像工具。IBD的全球疾病負擔持續增加，北美與歐洲已有數百萬患者受影響，亞洲與非洲的發生率則快速上升。標準化的檢查流程有助於提升一致性與診斷準確度。隨著治療選項擴展、病患預後改善，MRE的判讀已從單純偵測病灶，演進至疾病表型分類與預後指標評估。將MRE發現與更新後的疾病活動度指數及治療反應標準整合，對於指導當代IBD臨床決策至關重要。

papers.title: MR Imaging of Anal Cancer
papers.journal: Magn Reson Imaging Clin N Am
papers.journal_full: Magnetic resonance imaging clinics of North America
papers.authors: Young P, Golia Pernicka J, Jing A, Ernst R, Rauch G
papers.abstract: High-resolution pelvic MR imaging is central to the diagnosis, staging, treatment planning, and posttreatment assessment of anal squamous cell carcinoma (SCCA), the most common malignancy of the anal canal. Accurate imaging interpretation requires detailed knowledge of anal canal anatomy, lymphatic drainage, and optimized MR imaging technique. MR imaging provides excellent evaluation of primary tumor extent, while nodal and distant staging are enhanced by computed tomography (CT) and FDG-PET/CT. Imaging directly informs contemporary chemoradiation strategies and surveillance. Human papillomavirus (HPV) is implicated in nearly 90% of SCCA, is vaccine-preventable, and HPV ctDNA shows promise for response assessment and relapse prediction.

papers.title_zh: 肛門癌之磁振造影檢查
papers.abstract_zh: 高解析度骨盆腔磁振造影（MR imaging）在肛門鱗狀細胞癌（SCCA，肛管最常見的惡性腫瘤）之診斷、分期、治療計畫擬定及治療後評估中扮演核心角色。準確的影像判讀需要詳細了解肛管解剖構造、淋巴引流路徑，以及最佳化的MR造影技術。MR造影可提供原發腫瘤範圍的優良評估，而淋巴結與遠端分期則可藉由電腦斷層（CT）及FDG-PET/CT加強評估。影像直接影響當代化放療策略之制定與追蹤監測。人類乳突病毒（HPV）與近90%的SCCA相關，可透過疫苗預防，而HPV ctDNA在治療反應評估與復發預測方面展現潛力。

papers.title: MR imaging of Rectal Cancer
papers.journal: Magn Reson Imaging Clin N Am
papers.journal_full: Magnetic resonance imaging clinics of North America
papers.authors: Kassam Z, Lee S, Maheshwari E, Wasnik A
papers.abstract: MR imaging strengthens contemporary management of rectal cancer by depicting tumor extent, mesorectal fascia proximity, and nodal disease with exquisite anatomic detail. Both standardized technique and synoptic reporting improve reproducibility and multidisciplinary planning. Accurate T-category assignment, measurement of the circumferential resection margin, and recognition of extramural vascular invasion/tumor deposits stratify risk and help to triage patients into surgical, neoadjuvant or "watch-and-wait" pathways. Station-based evaluation of lateral pelvic nodes is critical to develop local control strategies. On restaging, a descriptive T2 + diffusion-weighted imaging framework differentiates treatment-related fibrosis from residual tumor to support organ-preserving options when appropriate.

related.title_zh: 全直腸新輔助治療（TNT）後之磁振造影：以治療導向反應評估作為觀察等待（Watch-and-Wait）處置之報告依據
related.one_liner: 本文回顧TNT後直腸癌MRI再分期策略，說明以DWI+內視鏡取代TRG以更安全篩選W&W候選病人。

papers.title_zh: 直腸癌之磁振造影檢查
papers.abstract_zh: 磁振造影（MRI）藉由精細描繪腫瘤範圍、與直腸繫膜筋膜之距離及淋巴結病變，強化了當代直腸癌的治療管理。標準化的掃描技術與結構化報告（synoptic reporting）可提升可重現性與多科團隊治療規劃之品質。精準的T分期、環周切除緣（circumferential resection margin, CRM）之測量，以及壁外血管侵犯（extramural vascular invasion）／腫瘤沉積（tumor deposits）之辨識，有助於風險分層，並協助將病人分流至手術、新輔助治療或『觀察等待（watch-and-wait）』等不同路徑。以站別（station-based）評估側方骨盆淋巴結，對於發展局部控制策略至關重要。在重新分期（restaging）時，描述性的T2加權合併擴散加權影像（DWI）架構可區分治療後纖維化與殘餘腫瘤，在適當情況下支持器官保留的治療選項。
papers.score_reason: 為敘述性回顧文章，無新數據或原始研究結果，但系統性整理了直腸癌MRI分期與再分期的臨床應用架構，對臨床實務具教育性參考價值。
papers.relevance_why: MRI分期是大腸直腸外科決定手術、新輔助治療或觀察等待策略的核心工具，直接影響臨床決策流程。
papers.one_liner: 本文回顧直腸癌MRI於T分期、CRM、EMVI、側方淋巴結評估及再分期之應用架構，未提供新數據。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；可作為內部教學或建立標準化MRI報告範本之參考資料，而非改變治療決策依據。

papers.title: Imaging of Colonic Malignancies
papers.journal: Magn Reson Imaging Clin N Am
papers.journal_full: Magnetic resonance imaging clinics of North America
papers.authors: Darwish A, Lalwani N, Kanmaniraja D, Yee J
papers.abstract: This comprehensive review outlines current imaging strategies for the evaluation and management of colonic malignancies. It explores anatomic considerations, histologic subtypes with distinct imaging features, and the evolving role of advanced modalities such as computed tomography colonography, radiomics, and MR spectroscopy. Emphasis is placed on tumor detection, accurate staging, response assessment, and surgical planning. Radiologists play a pivotal role in optimizing care across all phases of disease.
